integrity.literature_boundary: The vector-frame predecessor was compared because the target article explicitly presents the result as an extension of operator-theoretic K-frame results.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact two-dimensional projection counterexample and direct analysis-operator arguments.
integrity.unproved_limits: No full characterization of coefficient maps sufficient for the general dense-range K case is asserted.

scientific_limitations: The coefficient-range spanning condition is proved necessary for a universal invertibility conclusion of this postcomposition type, but is not claimed sufficient by itself.
The onto-analysis sufficient repair is stated only in the ordinary g-frame specialization.
An unindexed erratum, thesis remark, or informal correction may contain the same theorem-specific observation.
title: Coefficient-range projections refute an operator invertibility theorem for generalized frames
